verdict.rationale: Fastmail's docs show one-time Scheduled Send, event-triggered Filters & Rules, and Snooze, but there is no evidence of recurring/cron-like job scheduling or workflow automation that an AI agent could set up and have repeat on a schedule. JMAP's API access (fastmail-docs-1, fastmail-probe-rt-1/2) would let an external agent build such automation itself, but Fastmail itself does not document any recurring-job or workflow-scheduling capability.
